pairs.name: Centaur Warrunner
pairs.reason: Retaliate will shred through Windranger's health if she chooses to attack him during Focus Fire. Stampede can help his teammates escape from Windrun and Focus Fire.

pairs.name: Bloodseeker
pairs.reason: Rupture turns Windranger's mobility against her. Blood Rite's silence makes Windranger totally useless, since she's extremely reliant on abilities.

pairs.name: Axe
pairs.reason: Windranger’s long channeling Focus Fire makes her a prime target for Berserker’s Call. Axe forces her to attack him, triggering counter helix and controlling her. She gets countered hard during her burst window.
